## Requirements (from the contract)

1. Implement only the owner-bound slice tested by AC-1 and AC-2, with
   admitted durable/wire compatibility and reuse of lower-layer
   codecs/stores: `closure_walk` owner-typed traversal (Packet C C.1
   item 3) + `closure_report` access/loss/procedure verdicts (item 4)
   inside `hh-bundle` — in-process owner interfaces, no public RPC
   (C.4); owning codecs enumerate references — no hash regex, no
   second class table; visited dedup `{parent, role, field, media,
   size}` + explicit traversal limits; every required edge resolves to
   verified member bytes or explicit `fetch`/`redacted`/`gc`;
   `present` requires recipient bytes, never a producer assertion;
   fetch rides the landed `fetch::fetch` trust/expiry/locator rules —
   it never executes; no producer home/cache/path/credential fallback;
   report cannot raise `max_supported_level` (sidecar-class).
2. Retain the regression/evidence and per-target acceptance mapping
   under `docs/build/runs/R5.22.md` and its PR record; index only
   actual results.
3. Consume predecessor contracts unchanged — R5.21's
   `evidence-package/1` profile/ProfileIndex/member membership, R5.14
   pending/settlement classes, R5.15 population, R5.19/20 wire path.
   A new shared/persisted decision belongs in the owning ADR
   admission, not an implementation-local substitute.

## Acceptance criteria (from the contract)

- [ ] AC-1 (D/E; positive): enumerate ordinary and
    payload/IR/cause/lineage roots with owner types, visited-set/
    limits/edge provenance; resolve member/fetch/redacted/gc
    truthfully; recipient materialization works with inaccessible
    producer home/store/cache/credentials.

## Plan

- New module `crates/hh-bundle/src/closure.rs` — the in-process owner
  interface `closure_walk(decoded, opts) → ClosureReport`:
  - **Root enumeration** (owner-typed; each edge carries
    `{parent, role, field, media, size, owner, kind, target}`):
    - `members[]` rows — member edges (owner `hh-bundle.manifest`);
    - `levels::section_member_refs` + `resolved_dependencies.
      run_refs` values — ordinary refs (owners `hh-bundle.manifest`,
      `hh-bundle.run_refs`);
    - `composition.contains[].member` — manifest edges into contained
      `hh-bundle/1` manifests (recursion, depth-limited);
    - `evidence_profile` section → decode member → claim
      `native_refs[]`/`report_refs[]` + declared coordinate refs
      (subject_run/launch_binding/settlement/instrument_event/
      selection/supersedes/sealed_*_digest/oracle*_ref exports
      last_event run) — owner `evidence-package/1`;
    - per subject run trace (`traces.<run>`): tree + page member
      edges, `blob_index[]` status edges (owner `hh-ledger.
      blob_index`), head + checkpoint/audit `EventRef` edges, lineage
      prefix edges (`lineage` kind), page decode → per event
      `causes[]` (kind cause), `refs[]`/`payload content_refs`
      (kind payload; owners `hh-ledger.envelope:<class>`,
      `hh-ledger.class_table:<class>`), `ir_refs[]` (kind ir).
    - unregistered event class or an undecodable required member →
      `unknown_class`/`unsupported_schema`/`malformed` closure failure.
  - **Visited dedup** on the `{parent, role, field, media, size}` key;
    expansion-stack set detects cycles (cycle ⇒ failure, never pass);
    `ClosureLimits{max_edges, max_depth, max_events}` — exhaustion
    fails `traversal_limit` (whole closure, never a partial pass).
  - **Resolution** per dedup'd edge: member status — `present`
    requires `decoded.members[addr]` bytes recomputing to the address
    (`idp_id("blob", bytes)`; size agreement) → `resolved` — never a
    producer assertion; `fetch` → materialize through the landed
    `fetch::fetch` (exact identity, trust/expiry/locator admission,
    verified arrival, never executes) when `opts.fetch` is supplied —
    else `withheld{fetch_declared}`; `redacted`/`gc` → `withheld`;
    no member row → blob_index status, then unindexed member bytes,
    else `unresolved{missing_member}`; cause/coordinate refs resolve
    against decoded events/runs truthfully.
  - **`closure_report`**: `{schema:"closure-report/1", bundle_id,
    profile_version, procedure, recipient_class, checked_at,
    required, resolved, withheld, unresolved, verdict, failures[]}`
    — verdict `closed` | `withheld` | `failed`; pure over bundle
    bytes + permitted fetch; cannot raise a level (sidecar-class,
    no max_supported_level join).
- `lib.rs`: `pub mod closure` + re-exports.
- `crates/hh-bundle/tests/r5_22.rs`: AC-1/AC-2 battery.
- Records: ADR (implementation landing record), coverage dated
  contributing note (REQ-F-005 achieved engineered D/E; owed legs
  named), BL append if a revisit trigger is owed, pr/R5.22.md.

## Test matrix (from ACs — written before implementation)

- T1 closure_walk_full_bundle_resolves (AC-1): assemble bundle with
  profile + offloaded blob members present → verdict `closed`;
  edge provenance carries owner/kind; report fields bound
  (bundle_id, profile_version, procedure, recipient_class,
  checked_at, counts).
- T2 visited_dedup_and_limits (AC-1/AC-2): shared refs dedup to one
  counted edge; `max_edges`/`max_depth`/`max_events` exhaustion →
  `traversal_limit` failure, never a partial pass.
- T3 fetch_statuses_truthful (AC-1): `fetch` member materializes via
  permitted `fetch::fetch` (pool fetcher) → resolved `via: fetch`;
  `redacted`/`gc` → `withheld`; verdict `withheld` not `failed`.
- T4 payload_only_loss_fails (AC-2): event `refs[]`/blob_index
  present row with no member bytes → `unresolved`; removing a page
  member fails; wrong member bytes (digest mismatch) fails.
- T5 unsupported_schema_and_unknown_class (AC-2): page member whose
  events carry an unregistered class; contains member whose bytes
  declare `hh-bundle/2`/garbage → failure codes.
- T6 cycle_cannot_pass (AC-2): `contains:` member whose decoded
  manifest contains its own member address (self-nest) → `cycle`
  failure, walk terminates.
- T7 fetch_refusals (AC-2): fetch member with expired entry /
  unauthorized location (no policy) / wrong bytes returned /
  no fetcher → typed unresolved reasons; no producer home/store/
  cache/credential fallback (walk over `Decoded` only — no `Store`
  parameter exists); fetched bytes never executed (no exec path).
- T8 legacy_no_profile_still_walks (AC-1): pre-R5.21 manifest (no
  evidence_profile) → `profile_version: null`, closure over
  declared edges still truthful.
- T9 report_is_sidecar (AC-2/AC-5): report does not join
  `max_supported_level`/levels — a `closed` verdict mutates no
  level basis; to_json round-trip stable.

The complete AC-1+AC-2 implementation measures **2,073 changed
source/test lines** vs the contract's **≤1,000 split trigger**

(`git diff --cached --numstat -- '*.rs'` at the checkpoint commit —
code+test only; docs/records excluded.)

The weight is the admitted enumeration, not padding: §6.2 names
eight owner-typed root classes (manifest members, section refs,
composition manifests, profile claim/coordinate refs, run-manifest
ordinary refs, trace tree/pages/blob_index/head/checkpoint/lineage,
event causes/refs/ir_refs, class-table `content_refs`) each with
`{parent, role, field, media, size}` provenance + owner, dedup, DFS
expansion with cycle detection, three explicit limits, per-status
resolution (present/fetch/redacted/gc) against the *declaring* index
(outer + `contains:` manifests), the landed `fetch::fetch` batch,
and the sidecar `closure-report/1` codec. No AC was dropped.

**Seam analysis.** Candidate cuts: (a) enumeration vs (b)
resolution+report — rejected: the report is the enumeration's own
fold (no independent contract), and the negative ACs live in
resolution while the positive AC lives in enumeration, so either
leg alone cannot execute its half of AC-1/AC-2. (c) Ledger-export
expansion vs profile/ordinary/composition roots — rejected: a
partial traversal silently mis-reports closure (a recipient verdict
over unenumerated classes would claim resolved edges the ticket
requires to be enumerable). Packet C names ONE owner for this
slice — hh-bundle's in-process closure interface (C.2/C.4); no
documented consumer seam exists inside it. Same objection shape the
R5.19/R5.20/R5.21 scoped reviews found.

**Magnitude:** ~2.0× is inside the accepted band (≤2.6× R5.8;
~1.9–2.4× routinely amended incl. R5.21 at ~2.4×).

**Proposed disposition:** AMEND — land the walk + report as one
unit; the implementation is complete and green (hh-bundle 95/0
incl. r5_22 9/9; fmt + clippy clean; fails-without compile-red at
base `79b13533` — `hharness_bundle::closure` does not exist there),
checkpointed below for review. If SPLIT is preferred, the weakest
documented cut is (a) `closure_walk` enumeration+dedup+limits+event
ref classes → (b) member/fetch/redacted/gc resolution +
`closure_report` — leg (a) remains over-trigger alone.
